clicker.home.hint_on: Press %s or click here to switch it off
clicker.home.hint_off: Press %s or click here to switch it on
clicker.home.live_line: Live: %s clicks in the last second
clicker.clicking.left.subtitle: Attack and break
clicker.clicking.right.subtitle: Use and place
clicker.clicking.desc.left.toggle: Attacks continuously while Clicker is on.
clicker.clicking.desc.left.hold: Keeps attacking while you hold the attack button.
clicker.clicking.desc.right.toggle: Uses items continuously while Clicker is on.
clicker.clicking.desc.right.hold: Keeps using items while you hold the use button.
clicker.clicking.tip: Clicker only runs while it is switched on (G) and no screen is open. Hold mode follows your own mouse buttons, so you never need to spam them.
clicker.double.title: Double Click
clicker.double.subtitle: Pairs every generated click
clicker.double.explanation: Each click Clicker sends is followed by a second click after the delay you choose, which doubles the clicks per second. Your own manual clicks are never doubled.
clicker.protection.title: Right-click protection
clicker.protection.subtitle: Pauses automation for valuable items
clicker.protection.explanation: Right clicks pause while one of these is in either hand and resume when you switch. Manual clicks always work.
clicker.protection.golden_apple.desc: Never eat a stack by accident
clicker.protection.live.off: Protection is off: right clicks are never paused
clicker.protection.live.no_world: Join a world to see what you are holding
clicker.theme.blossom.desc: Airy white with a touch of pink
clicker.themes.hint: Themes restyle everything and save automatically.
clicker.settings.keybinds.hint: Click, then press a key. Esc cancels, Backspace clears. Orange = shared key.
clicker.dialog.reset.title: Reset all settings?
clicker.dialog.reset.message: Clicking, double click, protection, theme and interface settings return to their defaults. Your keybinds are kept.
